# Stored file formats

No JSON. Everything the application stores is Python source holding plain values:

```python
# Generated by Engine DAQ Telemetry. Plain values only.
from math import inf, nan

data = {
    'name': 'Rig_A',
    'rangeMin': nan,
}
```

`edaq.codefile` loads these by checking the syntax tree. Only literals, `nan` and `inf` are
accepted; anything else is refused and nothing is executed. Unset numbers are `nan`.

## Setups (`workspace/setups/*.py`, schema 2)

Top-level keys: `schemaVersion`, `name`, `parameters`, `devices`, `channels`, `crossRules`, `engine`.
`current.py` (last working state) and `rejected_*.py` (could not be loaded) are reserved.

## Run folder (schema 2)

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `manifest.py` | `schemaVersion`, `runtime`, `appVersion`, `startT`, `endT`, `source`, `channels` (position gives the 1-based channel index), `devices`, `setup`, `configSha256`, `context` |
| `samples.bin` | Little-endian float64 records of 5 values: `t` (POSIX s), channel index, flags, raw, value |
| `events.py` | `data = []` followed by one `data.append({...})` per event. An incomplete final line is ignored |

## Quality flags

`RANGE 1, ROC 2, STUCK 4, NOISE 8, OUTLIER 16, THRESHOLD 32, CROSS 64, TIMESTAMP 128, COMM 256,
MISSING 512, DRIFT 1024, CALIBRATION 2048, INTERVAL 4096, DERIVED_INPUT 8192`. Append only.

## Reading files from the MATLAB build

Optional, and needs no MATLAB. Setups, dashboards and runs saved by the MATLAB build can be
opened: `.m` files are parsed as text, never run. They must contain only literal assignments
to `data`, one per line, after an optional function header and comments:

```
target  := data ( .name | {n} | (n) )*        n is 1-based
value   := number | true | false | text ( + newline + text )*
           | [numbers separated by space or ;] | [texts separated by , or ;]
           | [] | {} | struct() | struct([]) | strings(r, c)
number  := -?digits[.digits][e[+-]digits] | Inf | -Inf | NaN
text    := "..." with embedded quotes doubled
```

## Expression grammar

```
or      := and ('||' and)*
and     := cmp ('&&' cmp)*
cmp     := add (('<'|'<='|'>'|'>='|'=='|'!=') add)*
add     := mul (('+'|'-') mul)*
mul     := unary (('*'|'/'|'%') unary)*
unary   := ('-'|'+'|'!') unary | power
power   := atom ('^' unary)?
atom    := number | identifier | identifier '(' args ')' | '(' or ')'
```

So `-2^2` is `-4` and `2^3^2` is `512`. Comparisons and logic return 1 or 0. Constants: `pi`, `e`.
Functions: `sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sqrt abs exp log log10 floor ceil round sign min max
pow if clamp`.
